description: This file contains functions for automating educational workflows such as student enrollment, attendance, fee collection, and schedule creation within an ERP system, specifically for the 'education' module of ERPNext.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Main workflow function that sets user, enrolls students, marks attendance, and makes fees.

methods.name: approve_random_student_applicant
methods.description: Approves a random student applicant with weighted probability.

methods.name: enroll_random_student
methods.description: Enrolls a randomly approved student into courses and fees for the current date.

methods.name: assign_student_group
methods.description: Assigns students to appropriate student groups based on program, course, and batch.

methods.name: mark_student_attendance
methods.description: Records attendance for students in each batch group.

methods.name: make_fees
methods.description: Generates and collects fees for students with unpaid fees.

methods.name: make_assessment_plan
methods.description: Creates assessment plans for student groups and courses.

methods.name: make_course_schedule
methods.description: Schedules courses for student groups over a date range.

methods.name: weighted_choice
methods.description: Selects an index based on weighted probabilities.
